about: T3.11's vectors: the reference's PredictiveQuery constructor on each S0 query text and on blank texts (reference), and Python's binding's answers to each S0 case's validate_query and to the test-only fail operation for every contract error code (binding). java/src/test/java/com/nvidia/sdm/ holds the Java host to them.

s0.accept.binary-classification.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, 0, 30, days) > 0 FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.accept.sum-window.text: PREDICT SUM(orders.price, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.boundary.date-long-field.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.* WHERE orders.ts > 2024-01-01 00000:00:00, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.boundary.date-packed.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.* WHERE orders.ts > 20240101/00/123456, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.date-impossible.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.* WHERE orders.ts > 2023-02-29, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.join-event-filter.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id WHERE orders.price > 1

s0.refuse.model-implicit-join.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.* WHERE users.age > 30, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.parse-syntax.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, 0, 30, days FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.target-foreign-key.text: PREDICT FIRST(orders.user_id, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.task-forecast-zero.text: PREDICT SUM(orders.price, 0, 7, days) FORECAST 0 TIMEFRAMES FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.time-past-window.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, -30, 0, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.type-constant.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.*, 0, 30, days) = 'x' FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.unknown-column.text: PREDICT SUM(orders.cost, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

s0.refuse.value-int64.text: PREDICT COUNT(orders.* WHERE orders.price > 9223372036854775808, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

text.non-ascii.text: PREDICT users.country = 'Zürich 東京' FOR EACH users.user_id
